instruction: Could you configure GIMP to hide the rulers on the image canvas?

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling rulers in GIMP. Uses existing check_config_status metric to verify show-rulers setting in sessionrc config file. Similar complexity to original - single view configuration change.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to hide rulers in GIMP
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP to ensure sessionrc config file is saved
Getter (get_gimp_config_file) correctly retrieves the sessionrc config file from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/
Metric (check_config_status) correctly parses GIMP config format and checks for key-value pairs
Expected value is semantically correct: show-rulers=no means rulers are hidden
Complete coverage: the single requirement (hide rulers) is fully verified
Logic flow is sound and will work correctly at runtime
